help.restartTourDescription: A short walkthrough of the app's main features.

diary.title: What the Health Diary is for
diary.body: Log what happened to your pet and what worked — next time you'll see a proven solution.
diary.example: e.g. “Tick on the back → removed, gave Bravecto, worked.”

passport.title: What the Health Passport is for
passport.body: Keep vaccinations, dewormings, medications and weight in one place and track due dates.
passport.example: e.g. the next rabies booster date and a history of visits.

vetCard.title: What the Vet Card is for
vetCard.body: Print a clear summary with everything the vet needs before each visit.
vetCard.example: e.g. active medications, recent vaccinations and recent issues on one page.

analyze.title: What the Analysis is for
analyze.body: Snap or paste a food's ingredients and AI tells you whether it suits your pet.
analyze.example: e.g. a chicken allergen warning for a dog with a food allergy.

history.title: What the History is for
history.body: All your past food analyses in one place, so you can compare foods and revisit results.
history.example: e.g. compare the scores of two kibbles you're choosing between.

profiles.title: What Pet Profiles are for
profiles.body: Keep each pet's breed, age, allergies and conditions here — analyses and the passport use them.
profiles.example: e.g. add a chicken allergy so food analysis warns you automatically.

checkIn.title: What Check-in is for
checkIn.body: Tick off how your pet is doing once a week — regular records reveal patterns over time.
checkIn.example: E.g. “No changes” every Sunday; when something goes wrong you see exactly when it started.

food.title: What Food is for
food.body: Track what your pet currently eats, treats included — Pawly links it to your check-ins.
food.example: E.g. digestive trouble only appeared two weeks after switching food.

notifications.title: What Reminders are for
notifications.body: Choose which due dates you want an e-mail about, and how far in advance.
notifications.example: E.g. a warning 30 days before the rabies booster.

welcome.title: Welcome to Pawly
welcome.body: Pawly keeps your pet's health in one place — food ingredients, vaccinations, due dates and a record of what happened when. Nothing to memorise, nothing to dig out of a drawer.

profile.title: Start with a pet profile
profile.body: Create a profile — name, breed, age and, above all, allergies and health conditions. The whole app draws on it, so food analysis can warn you about exactly what doesn't suit your pet.

passport.title: Health passport and due dates
passport.body: Record vaccinations, dewormings and medication — or simply photograph the old paper booklet and Pawly will extract the entries. It then reminds you of upcoming dates, and you can print a vet card before an appointment.

routine.title: A short weekly routine
routine.body: Tick off a check-in once a week, note the current food and log bigger problems in the diary. From these small entries Pawly builds up the connections — that trouble started after a food change, for instance.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Add Pawly to your phone or desktop home screen and use it like a native app — offline too. The “?” button in the bottom right always has a guide for the page you're on.

hints.currentFood: The current food is what your pet eats right now. When you change it, the previous one is closed automatically with today's date and moved to history — so you can look back and see what it ate and when.
hints.treats: Treats, snacks and supplements. They are the most common hidden source of allergens — even when the main food is fine, something from this list can cause a reaction.
hints.foodInsights: A comparison of food changes with symptoms from your check-ins. This is a statistical link, not a diagnosis — the more check-ins you have, the more reliable it gets.
hints.checkInQuestion: One answer is enough to save a check-in. Details are optional — add them when you notice something.
hints.leadDays: How many days before the due date you get an e-mail. You can pick several values at once — 30 days to book the vet and 7 days as a reminder, for example.
